    others=sorted([c for c in cnt if c!=bg], key=lambda c:sum(r.count(c) for r in I))
    dc=others[-1]; sc=others[0]
    seen=set(); B=[]
    for cell in [(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]==dc]:
        if cell in seen: continue
        q=deque([cell]); comp=[cell]; seen.add(cell)
        while q:
            x,y=q.popleft()
            for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                nx,ny=x+dx,y+dy
                if 0<=nx<H and 0<=ny<W and I[nx][ny]==dc and (nx,ny) not in seen:
                    seen.add((nx,ny)); comp.append((nx,ny)); q.append((nx,ny))
        B.append(comp)
    horiz = len({r for r,_ in B[0]})==1
    O=[r[:] for r in I]
    singles=[(sr,ss) for sr,ss in [(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]==sc]]
    for sr,ss in singles:
        anc = B[0] if ((horiz and ss in {c for _,c in B[0]}) or (not horiz and ss in {r for r,_ in B[0]})) else B[1]
        other = B[1] if anc is B[0] else B[0]
        a_lo=min(c for _,c in anc); o_lo=min(c for _,c in other)
        offs=[ss-a_lo]
        mi=[o_lo+off for off in offs]
        for lc in ([ss]+mi):
            span_lo=min(min(r for r,_ in anc),min(r for r,_ in other))
            span_hi=max(max(r for r,_ in anc),max(r for r,_ in other))
            if lc==ss:
                rng=list(range(span_lo,sr+1))
                for r in rng: O[r][lc]=sc
            else:
                for r in range(span_lo,span_hi+1):
                    if lc<W: O[r][lc]=sc
        O[sr][ss]=4
    return O

from collections import Counter, deque
def solve(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in I for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    others=sorted([c for c in cnt if c!=bg], key=lambda c:sum(r.count(c) for r in I))
    dc=others[-1]; sc=others[0]
    # bars = components of dc with size>=2
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]==dc]
    seen=set(); B=[]
    for cell in cells:
        if cell in seen: continue
        q=deque([cell]); comp=[cell]; seen.add(cell)
        while q:
            x,y=q.popleft()
            for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                nx,ny=x+dx,y+dy
                if 0<=nx<H and 0<=ny<W and I[nx][ny]==dc and (nx,ny) not in seen:
                    seen.add((nx,ny)); comp.append((nx,ny)); q.append((nx,ny))
        B.append(set(comp))
    horiz = len({r for r,_ in B[0]})==1
    O=[r[:] for r in I]
    singles=[(sr,ss) for sr,ss in [(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]==sc]]
    def span():
        br=min(min(r for r,_ in b) for b in B); be=max(max(r for r,_ in b) for b in B)
        return range(br,be+1)
    for sr,ss in singles:
        if horiz:
            anc = B[0] if ss in {c for _,c in B[0]} else B[1]
            oth = B[1] if anc is B[0] else B[0]
            offs=[ss-min(c for _,c in anc)]
            for off in offs+[offs[0]]:
                lc = min(c for _,c in oth)+off
                if lc<0 or lc>=W: continue
                arows=[min(r for r,_ in anc),max(r for r,_ in anc)]
                for r in span():
                    if (r,l c_:=lc) and r not in arows and not (min(r for r,_ in anc)<=r<=max(r for r,_ in anc) and False): pass
            # own: fill from anc bar toward single, stop at single
            rng=list(range(min(arows), sr+1)) if sr>=min(arows) else list(range(max(arows),sr-1,-1))
            for r in rng: O[r][ss]=sc if r!=sr else 4
            O[sr][ss]=4
            # mirror: full span
            for r in span():
                if r not in (min(r for r,_ in anc),max(r for r,_ in anc)): O[r][lc]=sc
        else:
            anc = B[0] if ss in {r for r,_ in B[0]} else B[1]
            oth = B[1] if anc is B[0] else B[0]
            offs=[ss-min(r for r,_ in anc)]
            for off in offs:
                lr = min(r for r,_ in oth)+off
                if lr<0 or lr>=H: continue
                acols=[min(c for _,c in anc),max(c for _,c in anc)]
                rng=list(range(min(acols), ss+1)) if ss>=min(acols) else list(range(max(acols),ss-1,-1) )[::-1][:0]
                rng=list(range(min(acols), sr+1)) if False else list(range(min(acols),ss+1)) if ss>=min(acols) else list(range(max(acols),ss-1,-1))
                for c in rng: O[lr][c]=sc if c!=ss else 4
                O[lr][ss]=4
                for c in span_cols(): O[lr][c]=sc
    return O

from collections import Counter, deque
def solve(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in I for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    others=sorted([c for c in cnt if c!=bg], key=lambda c:sum(r.count(c) for r in I))
    dc=others[-1]; sc=others[0]
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]==dc]
    seen=set(); B=[]
    for cell in cells:
        if cell in seen: continue
        q=deque([cell]); comp=[cell]; seen.add(cell)
        while q:
            x,y=q.popleft()
            for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                nx,ny=x+dx,y+dy
                if 0<=nx<H and 0<=ny<W and I[nx][ny]==dc and (nx,ny) not in seen:
                    seen.add((nx,ny)); comp.append((nx,ny)); q.append((nx,ny))
        B.append(comp)
    horiz = len({r for r,_ in B[0]})==1
    O=[r[:] for r in I]
    def bar_cells(bar): return set(bar)
    singles=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]==sc]
    for sr,ss in singles:
        if horiz:
            anc = B[0] if ss in {c for _,c in B[0]} else B[1]
            oth = B[1] if anc is B[0] else B[0]
            a_min=min(c for _,c in anc); o_min=min(c for _,c in oth)
            off=ss-a_min
            lc=o_min+off
            # own line: from single toward anchor bar
            a_top=min(r for r,_ in anc); a_bot=max(r for r,_ in anc)
            for r in range(a_top,sr+1):
                O[r][ss]=sc if r!=sr else 4
            # mapped line: full span between bars, skip bar cells
            b_top=min(r for r,_ in oth); b_bot=max(r for r,_ in oth)
            for r in range(b_top,b_bot+1):
                if O[r][lc]==dc: continue
                O[r][lc]=sc
        else:
            anc = B[0] if ss in {r for r,_ in B[0]} else B[1]
            oth = B[1] if anc is B[0] else B[0]
            a_min=min(r for r,_ in anc); o_min=min(r for r,_ in oth)
            off=sr-a_min
            lr=o_min+off
            a_lft=min(c for _,c in anc); a_rgt=max(c for _,c in anc)
            for c in range(a_lft,ss+1):
                O[lr][c]=sc if c!=ss else 4
            b_lft=min(c for _,c in oth); b_rgt=max(c for _,c in oth)
            for c in range(b_lft,b_rgt+1):
                if O[lr][c]==dc: continue
                O[lr][c]=sc
    return O
ok=True
for i in (1,2,3,4,5):
    I=G[f'Demo pair {i} input']; Oexp=G[f'Demo pair {i} output']
    R=solve(I)
    print(i, R==Oexp)
    ok &= R==Oexp
print('ALL' if ok else 'MISMATCH')

def solve(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in I for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    others=sorted([x for x in cnt if x not in (bg,)], key=lambda c:sum(r.count(c) for r in I))
    sc=others[-1]; dc=others[0]  # smallest = singles; largest = bar color
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]==dc]
    seen=set(); bars=[]
    for cell in cells:
        if cell in seen: continue
        q=deque([cell]); comp=[cell]; seen.add(cell)
        while q:
            x,y=q.popleft()
            for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                nx,ny=x+dx,y+dy
                if 0<=nx<H and 0<=ny<W and I[nx][ny]==dc and (nx,ny) not in seen:
                    seen.add((nx,ny)); comp.append((nx,ny)); q.append((nx,ny))
        bars.append(comp)

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter as C, deque

def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def comps(I,bg):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0]); seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; out=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if I[r][c]!=bg and not seen[r][c]:
                st=deque([(r,c)]); cl=[]
                while st:
                    rr,cc=st.popleft(); cl.append((rr,cc))
                    for dr in(-1,0,1):
                        for dc in(-1,0,1):
                            nr,nc=rr+dr,cc+dc
                            if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and I[nr][nc]==I[r][c] and not seen[nr][nc]:
                                seen[nr][nc]=True; st.append((nr,nc))
                out.append(cl)
    return out

def solve(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    cnt=C(x for r in I for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    bars=comps(I,bg)
    bars.sort(key=len,reverse=True)
    barcells=set(p for b in bars for p in b)
    S=[]
    for b in bars:
        rs={r for r,_ in b}; cs={c for _,c in b}
        S.append(('h' if len(rs)==1 else 'v', min(cs),max(cs),min(rs),max(rs)))
    singles=[(r,c,I[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]!=bg and (r,c) not in barcells]
    O=[list(row) for row in I]
    for r,c,sc in singles:
        typ,a,b_,r0,r1=S[0]
        oth=S[1]
        # anchor: bar whose span contains cross-coord; else the nearer
        if typ=='h':
            contains=[i for i,(t_,a_,b__,r0_,r1_) in enumerate(S) if a_<=c<=b__]
            if contains: anc=S[contains[0]]
            else: anc=S[0 if abs(r-r0)<abs(r-r1) else 1]
            oth=S[1-len(contains)]
            o=a-b_
            step=1 if r>r0 else -1
            rr=r0+step
            while rr!=r:
                if (rr,c) not in barcells: O[rr][c]=sc
                rr+=step
            O[r][c]=4
            mr=oth[3]+o
            for cc in range(min(oth[1],oth[2]),max(oth[1],oth[2])+1):
                if (mr,cc) not in barcells: O[mr][cc]=sc
        else:
            contains=[i for i,(t_,a_,b__,r0_,r1_) in enumerate(S) if r0_<=r<=r1_]
            if contains: anc=S[contains[0]]
            else: anc=S[0 if abs(c-a)<abs(c-b_) else 1]
            oth=S[1-len(contains)]
            o=r0-r1
            step=1 if c>a else -1
            cc=a+step
            while cc!=c:
                if (r,cc) not in barcells: O[r][cc]=sc
                cc+=step
            O[r][c]=4
            mc=oth[0]+o
            for rr in range(min(oth[3],oth[4]),max(oth[3],oth[4])+1):
                if (rr,mc) not in barcells: O[rr][mc]=sc
    return O

allok=True
for k in range(1,9):
    I=G[f'Demo pair {k} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {k} output']
    R=solve(I); m=R==O; allok&=m; print(k,'match' if m else 'MISMATCH')
print('ALL' if allok else 'NOT ALL')
if allok:
    print(json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'])))

def solve(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in I for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps4(I,bg); cs.sort(key=lambda t:-len(t[1]))
    bars=[t for t in cs if len(t[1])>1]; singles=[c for c,_ in cs if len(_)==1]
    B=[b[1] for b in bars]; S=singles
    hbar=[b for b in B if len({r for r,c in b})==1 and len({c for r,c in b})>1]
    vbar=[b for b in B if len({c for r,c in b})==1 and len({r for r,c in b})>1]
    out=[row[:] for row in I]
    if len(hbar)==2:
        top,h=hbar; rt=min(r for r,c in top); bt=min(r for r,c in h)
        tspan=list(range(min(c for r,c in top),max(c for r,c in top)+1))
        bspan=list(range(min(c for r,c in h),max(c for r,c in h)+1))
        lo,hi=sorted([rt,bt])
        for (r,c) in S:
            sc=I[r][c]; out[r][c]=4
            oc=(min(c for r,cc in top)<=c<=max(c for r,cc in top) or min(c for r,cc in h)<=c<=max(c for r,cc in h))
            # stripe from anchor toward single: full corridor between bars at column c
            for rr in range(lo+1,hi):
                out[rr][c]=sc
            if oc:
                # mapped offset
                o=c-min(c for r,cc in top) if min(c for r,cc in top)<=c<=max(c for r,cc in top) else c-min(c for r,cc in h)
                m=min(c for r,cc in h)+o if min(c for r,cc in top)<=c<=max(c for r,cc in top) else min(c for r,cc in top)+o
                if m in bspan if min(c for r,cc in top)<=c<=max(c for r,cc in top) else (m in tspan):
                    for rr in range(lo+1,hi):
                        out[rr][m]=sc
    elif len(vbar)==2:
        left,right=vbar; lc=min(c for r,c in left); rc=min(c for r,c in right)
        lspan=list(range(min(r for r,c in left),max(r for r,c in left)+1))
        rspan=list(range(min(r for r,c in right),max(r for r,c in right)+1))
        lo,hi=sorted([lc,rc])
        for (r,c) in S:
            sc=I[r][c]; out[r][c]=4
            o=r-min(r for r,cc in left) if min(r for r,cc in left)<=r<=max(r for r,cc in left) else r-min(r for r,cc in right)
            m=min(r for r,cc in right)+o if min(r for r,cc in left)<=r<=max(r for r,cc in left) else min(r for r,cc in left)+o
            if m in (lspan if min(r for r,cc in left)<=r<=max(r for r,cc in left) else rspan):
                for cc2 in range(lo+1,hi):
                    out[r][cc2]=sc
    return out
